items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: So the guys he hung out with like me and the rest of the guys... We just know, that's our man.

ctx.x: Well, Pops was always a front row leader. He was highly respected by everybody, you know. But he hung out with the guys. So the guys he hung out with like me and the rest of the guys, we never in awe of him. We just know,

that's our man. We don't stand and look at him, (unintelligible) Pop's just our man, until he died. He was Duke's man. Great admiration between them. I was a great admirer of the work he'd done but not in complete awe. I never saw a guy was in awe -- like I looked up and my mouth fly open, can't say anything. He's just another turkey, I don't know.
It was just -- maybe you had a lot of guys that would say, "Oh, that's Louis Armstrong over there."
